title: 第1934章 陈稳的实力你这徒弟太夸张了第1933章 天宝沙尘暴你们小心
slug: 被问罪当天无上帝族杀来
content_zh:
第1934章陈稳的实力，你这徒弟太夸张了
此时此刻，他们已经够不上手了。
虽然这巨大的沙尘暴，被他们一分为三，威力大减。
但对于洛如画这些人，依旧有着巨大的压迫力。
尤其是陈稳，一个刚入六重大帝境不久，连一阶大帝意志都没有凝炼。
在这种情况下，又怎么可能是这沙尘暴的对手。
看着近在咫尺的沙尘暴，牧晴和诸葛弃姝的脸色都微微一变。
显然，他们都能感受到从这沙尘暴上传来的力量。
这对他们构成了巨大的威胁。
但在第一时间，他们在做出应对之势的同时，也下意识地看向陈稳。
在他们看来，如果连他们都有巨大的危机感，那对于陈稳来说又将如何？
怕是会不堪一击，甚至是直接被吓傻吧。
但很在，他们的瞳孔便猛然一缩。
因为陈稳看起来一副平静而从容的姿态。
相比于他们来说，陈稳要淡定太多太多了。
那就好像，他们才是那弱势的一方。
“你们分心了。”
陈稳淡淡地开口道。
那平静的声音，如同于惊雷一样，在她们的耳边炸开。
对。

差点忘了这一茬。
诸葛弃姝和牧晴立时浑身巨震，抬手快速起势。
下一刻，她们的攻势便与碾压而来的沙尘暴对轰在一起。
砰！！！
随着一声巨响炸开，无尽的反冲之力朝着方贯压而去。
那一团沙尘暴都炸荡开了，有着一阵粉尘往外扬开。
但沙尘暴并没有就此被捣毁，只是有了不少的消耗。
反观牧晴和诸葛弃姝，则是相继往后暴退。
虽然没有受到太大的伤害，但看起来并没有想象中的好受。
这怎么可能！！！
而在倒飞的时候，她们的目光也不由投向陈稳所在的方向。
惊人的一幕，映入了她们的眼帘。
只见陈稳平静地一步往前跨出，并做出拔剑之势。
以指为剑。
斩！！！
陈稳的指间萦绕着混沌剑气和滔天的剑力。
content_en:
Chapter 1934 Chen Wen’s strength is too exaggerated for your disciple.
At this moment, they were beyond their reach.
Although this huge sandstorm was split into three by them, its power was greatly reduced.
But there is still huge pressure on people like Luo Ruhua.
Especially Chen Wen, who has just entered the realm of the sixth great emperor, and has not even condensed the will of the first-level emperor.
In this case, how could he be the opponent of this sandstorm?
Seeing the sandstorm so close at hand, the expressions of Mu Qing and Zhuge Qishu changed slightly.
Obviously, they can all feel the power coming from this sandstorm.
This poses a huge threat to them.
But at the first moment, while they made a response, they also subconsciously looked at Chen Wen.
In their opinion, if even they have a huge sense of crisis, what will happen to Chen Wen?
I'm afraid I'll be vulnerable, or even scared out of my wits.
But very soon, their pupils suddenly shrank.
Because Chen Wen looked calm and calm.
Compared to them, Chen Wen is much calmer.
It's like they are the weak side.
"You're distracted."
Chen Wen said calmly.
The calm voice exploded in their ears like thunder.
right.
I almost forgot about this one.
Zhuge Qishu and Mu Qing were immediately shocked, and they raised their hands and quickly started to move.
The next moment, their offensive collided with the crushing sandstorm.
Bang! ! !
With a loud explosion, endless recoil force rushed towards Fang Guan.
The cloud of sandstorm exploded, and a burst of dust flew outward.
But the sandstorm was not destroyed, but a lot of consumption was incurred.
On the other hand, Mu Qing and Zhuge Qishu retreated violently one after another.
Although he didn't suffer much damage, it didn't look as good as he had imagined.
How is this possible! ! !
While flying upside down, their eyes couldn't help but cast their eyes in the direction of Chen Wen.
An astonishing scene caught their eyes.
Chen Wen calmly stepped forward and made a move to draw his sword.
Use your fingers as swords.
cut! ! !
Chaos sword energy and overwhelming sword power lingered between Chen Wen's fingers.
